steps.do: For each dispute, decide eligible_for_provisional_credit. It is true only if ALL of these hold. (1) The card account's date opened is at least 60 days before today (dp_time). (2) The reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge or duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with a purchase date more than 30 days before today. (3) The amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the card tier's maximum: Entry (Bronze, EcoCard, Business Bronze, Crypto-Cash Back) $2500.00; Mid $5000.00; Premium (Gold, Business Gold) $10000.00; Elite $15000.00; Diamond Elite $25000.00. (4) The customer has filed no more than 2 disputes from 12 months before today up to this filing; count them in dp_history, re-read before this filing. (5) For any reason other than unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, the customer contacted the merchant first.
steps.quote: Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:

basis.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days
'goods_services_not_received' (only if purchase was made more than 30 days ago)
3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)
Entry Tier (Bronze Rewards Card, EcoCard, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Crypto-Cash Back Card): Maximum $2500.00
Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00
Premium Tier (Gold Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card): Maximum $10000.00
Elite Tier (Platinum Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card): Maximum $15000.00
Invitation Tier (Diamond Elite Card): Maximum $25000.00
4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months
Use dispute_date and last_updated_at to understand timeline and recency.
5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first
Dispute reason is 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', or 'refund_never_processed'

steps.do: When the dispute count means not every eligible dispute can get provisional credit (each filing counts toward the next), tell the customer that the number of disputes in 12 months limits provisional credit, and ask which charges to file first. If they already named priorities (for example, the largest charges first), use them. File the eligible disputes first, in their order, then the rest. Do not recite internal counts.
